module.purpose: Defines tldraw's store-related types, asset and user integrations, validation behavior, and an integrity checker that repairs missing or invalid records.
module.summary: This module establishes the public contracts around a reactive tldraw record store. It defines asset upload and URL resolution, reactive user lookup, store configuration and snapshot types, validation error annotation, default page creation, and recursive integrity repair for documents, pointers, pages, instance state, cameras, page states, and shape references.
module.businessContext: Supports collaborative drawing persistence, asset delivery, user attribution, and reliable editor initialization. Failure can leave documents unusable, references invalid, or uploaded asset information exposed in diagnostics.
functions: redactRecordForErrorReporting (~L28-37): Removes asset source URLs before validation errors are reported.
createCachedUserResolve (~L275-286): Caches reactive user-resolution signals by user identifier.
onValidationFailure (~L382-407): Annotates validation failures and rethrows the original error.
getDefaultPages (~L409-418): Creates the initial default page record for an empty store.
createIntegrityChecker (~L445-541): Returns a recursive repair routine for store integrity.
ensureStoreIsUsable (~L449-538): Repairs missing records and invalid page-state references.

mutationOfArg: redactRecordForErrorReporting mutates asset record source fields in place.
createIntegrityChecker mutates the store by inserting, updating, and removing records.

units.name: redactRecordForErrorReporting

detail.name: redactRecordForErrorReporting
preconditions: record is an object with a typeName property.
When record.typeName is 'asset', record.props is accessible as an object.
postconditions: If record.typeName is not 'asset', record is unchanged.
If record.typeName is 'asset' and record has a src property, record.src equals '<redacted>'.
If record.typeName is 'asset' and record.props has a src property, record.props.src equals '<redacted>'.
invariants: Only source fields named src are modified.
Redaction uses the same literal value for the top-level and props source fields.
edgeCases: A non-asset record is not modified.
An asset without a top-level src property does not receive one through this function.
An asset whose props lacks a src property does not receive props.src through this function.
If an asset has both source fields, both are replaced with '<redacted>'.
stateMutations: Mutates record.src when the record is an asset and 'src' is present.
Mutates record.props.src when the record is an asset and 'src' is present in record.props.
detail.summary: Redacts asset source fields in a record before it is used for error reporting. Non-asset records are left unchanged.

specLiterals.role: Identifies records whose source fields require redaction.
Replacement value written to exposed asset source fields.

specTests.then: Both source fields retain their original values.
The function does not add either source property.

units.name: createCachedUserResolve

detail.name: createCachedUserResolve
detail.signature: export function createCachedUserResolve(resolveFn: (userId: string) => TLUser | null): (userId: string) => Signal<TLUser | null>
preconditions: resolveFn is callable and accepts a string user ID.
postconditions: Returns a function accepting a string user ID and producing a Signal<TLUser | null>.
The returned function caches the Signal associated with each user ID.
Repeated calls with the same user ID return the previously cached Signal.
invariants: The cache is private to the resolver function returned by this invocation.
User IDs are used as string cache keys.
Different user IDs do not share the same cached Signal.
edgeCases: A user ID not previously seen causes a Signal to be created and cached.
A repeated user ID returns the existing cached Signal rather than creating another one.
A resolver failure is not converted by this function and propagates according to the Signal or resolver behavior.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit input validation or recovery is specified.

stateMutations: Mutates a private in-memory Map held by the returned resolver by adding Signals for previously unseen user IDs.
detail.summary: Creates a resolver function that returns a cached Signal for each user ID. Each user ID is associated with one Signal instance reused across repeated lookups.

specTests.when: The returned function is called twice with the same user ID.
specTests.then: Both calls return the same Signal object.

specTests.when: The returned function is called with two different user IDs.
specTests.then: Each user ID receives its own cached Signal object.

units.name: onValidationFailure

detail.name: onValidationFailure
detail.signature: export function onValidationFailure({ error, phase, record, recordBefore }: StoreValidationFailure<TLRecord>): TLRecord
preconditions: The phase identifies the validation lifecycle stage.
postconditions: Returns a TLRecord when the failure is handled without aborting.
invariants: A validation failure during the initialize phase is treated as an existing validation issue, allowing invalid records to be loaded.
edgeCases: When phase is exactly 'initialize', the record is treated as pre-existing invalid data rather than newly introduced invalid data.
detail.summary: Handles validation failures for TLRecord values by using the validation context to preserve debugging information. During store initialization, invalid existing records are allowed so older buggy data can be loaded.

specLiterals.role: Identifies store initialization, during which existing invalid records are allowed.

units.name: createIntegrityChecker

detail.name: createIntegrityChecker
detail.signature: export function createIntegrityChecker(store: Store<TLRecord, TLStoreProps>): () => void
preconditions: store is a valid Store<TLRecord, TLStoreProps> with the required schema, query, get, has, put, and remove operations.
postconditions: When the returned function completes normally, the store has the required document and pointer records, at least one page, a valid current page for the instance, page states and cameras for all pages, and no page states referencing nonexistent pages.
invariants: The document record uses TLDOCUMENT_ID and the store's defaultName when created.
The pointer record uses TLPOINTER_ID when created.
The current page is selected as the first page after sorting by index when the instance is missing or references an unknown page.
Each existing page has an instance page state and camera record.
Page states referencing nonexistent pages are removed.
Missing records are created and invalid records are repaired until the store satisfies the integrity checks.
edgeCases: If the document record is missing, it is created and validation restarts.
If the pointer record is missing, it is created and validation restarts.
If there are no pages, default pages are created and validation restarts.
If the instance record is missing, it is created with the first page as currentPageId.
If the instance currentPageId does not identify an existing page, it is replaced with the first page ID.
If page states or cameras are missing, the corresponding records are created.
If a page state references a page that no longer exists, that page state is removed.
If a page state's croppingShapeId references a missing record, the croppingShapeId is cleared.
stateMutations: Mutates the supplied store by creating, updating, and removing integrity-related records.
detail.summary: Creates a callable integrity checker for a tldraw store. When invoked, the checker ensures required document, pointer, page, instance, page-state, and camera records exist and repairs invalid page references.

specLiterals.role: Record type queried to enumerate pages.
Record type queried to enumerate instance page states.

specTests.when: Create the checker and invoke it.
specTests.then: The store contains a document using store.props.defaultName, a pointer record, and the default page set.
The store contains an instance whose currentPageId is the first page by index, plus a page state and camera for every page.
The orphaned page state is removed; any surviving page state with a missing cropping shape has croppingShapeId set to null.

units.name: ensureStoreIsUsable

detail.name: ensureStoreIsUsable
preconditions: The supplied store supports the queried record types and the Store get, has, put, and remove operations.
The store schema provides the instance record type used to create the current instance state.
postconditions: A document record with TLDOCUMENT_ID exists.
A pointer record with TLPOINTER_ID exists.
A current instance record with TLINSTANCE_ID exists and references an existing page.
Every existing page has an instance page state and camera record.
Instance page states referencing nonexistent pages are removed.
invariants: Repairs are applied through store.put or store.remove and the integrity check is rerun after creating a missing document, pointer, page, or instance state.
The current page selected for a newly created or invalid instance is the first page when page records are sorted by index.
Generated instance page state identifiers correspond to their page identifiers.
Generated camera identifiers correspond to their page identifiers.
edgeCases: When the document record is absent, it is created using TLDOCUMENT_ID and store.props.defaultName, then validation restarts.
When the pointer record is absent, it is created using TLPOINTER_ID, then validation restarts.
When no pages exist, getDefaultPages() is inserted and validation restarts.
When the current instance record is absent, it is created with TLINSTANCE_ID and the first page as currentPageId, then validation restarts.
When the current instance references a nonexistent page, the existing instance is replaced with the first page as currentPageId, then validation restarts.
When pages lack instance page states or cameras, the missing records are inserted without restarting the check.
When an instance page state references a page that does not exist, that page state is removed.
stateMutations: Adds or replaces records in the supplied store via store.put.
Removes orphaned instance page state records from the supplied store via store.remove.
May mutate the supplied store's document, pointer, instance, page-state, and camera records.
detail.summary: Validates the required structural records and relationships in a TLStore, creating missing records and correcting invalid references until the store is usable.

specTests.then: The store is repaired so that the required document, pointer, at least one page, and current instance records exist, and the current instance references an existing page.
The instance record is updated so currentPageId is the ID of the first page after sorting pages by index.
The missing page state and camera are created for the existing page, and the orphaned instance page state is removed.
